resolutions.evidence: Original severity: Medium. invite.ts now has an allowlist in definiteInviteFailure(). A failure is definite only for AuthFailed or the reasons invalid_name, invalid_argument, invalid_payload, passphrase_missing, team_env_already_shared and onetime_store_full. Each of these is rejected before any write: onetime_store_full comes from store.reserve(), which in the provided core_team_commands runs before runner.run_parsed. Every other failure sets uncertainInvite=true and shows 'inv.unknown'. That includes Timeout/admin_timeout, InternalError admin_output_invalid/admin_output_missing, IoError admin_wait_failed and Unavailable. In that state the primary button changes to 'inv.checkInvites', which only closes the sheet (create(): `if (made || uncertainInvite) { onClose(); return; }`), so the invite cannot be resubmitted. The 'shared' wording comes from sharingCommitted, which is set only when team_share returned successfully (inside the onShared callback). team-components.test.ts exercises five uncertain classes and checks that team_invite_create is called once. No test results were observed.

Original severity: Medium. TeamPage replaced useIntent with an effect that returns early while `sheetBusyRef.current || sheets.isOpen('invite')`. The effect re-runs on [intent, incoming, sheetBusy, sheets.cur], so incoming join intents wait in the parent until the busy operation finishes and, for invite, until the user closes the sheet. onIncomingTaken() is not called until then.
(a) A newer join sheet cannot mount during team_join, so the old completion can no longer close a newer sheet.
(b) InviteSheet and JoinSheet now track alive and openRef. A link_ref delivered after unmount or close is discarded with an 'inv.late' toast. An unknown outcome after unmount shows 'inv.lateUnknown'.
The Join, Invite, Share and Remove section buttons check sheetBusyRef before opening.
User-acknowledgment requirement: met at the TeamPage level, because the invite sheet's `made` state blocks the intent until the user presses Done or closes the sheet. The parent routing of deep links is a limitation; see limitations.
The new defect N1 makes this guard block permanently after any ConfirmSheet use.

Original severity: Medium. For an unshared environment, InviteSheet renders `<Callout>{t('inv.pre2.note')}</Callout>` before confirmation. That copy includes '되돌릴 수 없고 권한은 다시 승인해요' ('it cannot be undone and permissions must be re-approved'). The primary label becomes 'inv.shareCreate' ('공유하고 초대 링크 만들기', 'Share and create invite link'). The onShared callback toasts and announces 'toast.share.done'. A persistent info Callout ('sharedHere.includes(env)') keeps the grant-reapproval notice visible after an invite failure. Component tests assert inv.pre2.note, the announce call and the toast text.

findings.title: ConfirmSheet never resets its running guard or reports onBusy(false); retries are silently ignored and TeamPage stays busy permanently, so deep-link joins never open
findings.evidence:
go() sets `running.current = true; onBusy?.(true); setBusy(true)`, but its finally block is only `finally { setBusy(false); }`. There is no `running.current = false` and no `onBusy?.(false)`.
Consequences:
(1) In every ConfirmSheet across the app, after the first attempt fails, for example a wrong admin passphrase that shows passErr, the next press returns at `if (running.current) return;` with no feedback. Resume, revoke, restore and similar actions cannot be retried without remounting the sheet.
(2) On TeamPage the share and remove sheets pass onBusy={reportBusy}. After any share or remove, whether it succeeds or fails, sheetBusyRef.current stays true and sheetBusy stays true.
(3) From then on the Join, Invite, Share and Remove buttons are all silent no-ops, because each checks `if (!sheetBusyRef.current)`.
(4) The intent effect returns early forever, so a zeropw://join deep link or a home 'invite' quick action is never opened and onIncomingTaken() is never called. The pending invite preview ref stays held in the parent until its core TTL.
This converts F2's busy guard into a permanent block. The new component tests do not exercise ConfirmSheet, so nothing catches it.
findings.fix:
Change the ConfirmSheet finally to `finally { running.current = false; onBusy?.(false); setBusy(false); }`, guarded with an alive ref as InviteSheet does if the sheet can unmount mid-run. Add component tests for the following:
- a wrong passphrase followed by a successful retry
- after a team share succeeds, a deep-link join intent opens the join sheet
- the Invite and Join buttons work after a share or remove

findings.title: The 'check invites' outcome can point to a list that is not shown
findings.evidence: If team_share itself has an uncertain outcome (for example Timeout), sharingCommitted stays false and the sheet shows 'inv.unknown' with the primary label 'inv.checkInvites'. Pressing it only calls onClose(). The TeamPage invite list renders only under `td?.shared`. So if the reload still reports the environment as unshared, or the read fails, there is no invite list to check. The guidance is honest but cannot be followed. No mutation is repeated, so this is not a safety issue.
findings.fix: After an uncertain outcome, reload the team data and show a state-specific message on the page, for example 'sharing state unknown: retry read'. Alternatively, keep the sheet open with a 'read state again' action that re-queries team_members and team_invites before allowing a new attempt.

findings.title: InviteSheet still drops keyboard focus: the name field is disabled while busy, and form-level errors are not focused
findings.evidence: The recipient field is rendered with `disabled={busy}`. If the user submits with Enter from that field, it becomes disabled while focused and focus falls to body. The env SelectField is also disabled while busy. On a definite or uncertain failure the code sets errs.form ('error.generic', 'inv.failedShared' or 'inv.unknown') as a role=alert line but moves no focus. Only the AuthFailed path focuses passRef. DESIGN.md §5.4 and §7 require keeping focus (aria-disabled) and moving focus to the error. JoinSheet's local field has the same `disabled={busy}` pattern, but its post-busy rAF effect recovers focus to the link field.
findings.fix: Use ariaDisabled plus the existing onChange guards on inv-name and inv-env instead of `disabled`. Add a post-render effect keyed on [busy, errs.form] that moves focus to the form error. Make the error element focusable with tabIndex={-1}, or focus the primary button.

limitations: Static, tool-free source reading only. No tests, type checks, builds, native or sandboxed macOS runs, or E2E were executed or observed. Test pass status is not assumed. The user-approved macOS sandbox exception was not exercised by this reviewer.

App.tsx and Dashboard.tsx were not provided. Whether a deep link that arrives while the invite sheet shows a fresh link is routed without remounting TeamPage could not be verified. A remount would discard the unacknowledged link before the user confirms it. Also unverified: whether a second deep link replacing a still-queued `incoming` discards the first ref.

Core and CLI behavior was taken from the provided docs and core_team_commands excerpt: team share reauthenticating natively without --require-admin, the reason codes emitted before mutation, the TTLs, and slot reservation order. It was not verified against the full Rust source.
Whether core team_join tolerates a concurrent onetime_discard of the same preview ref (JoinSheet unmounting mid-join) could not be determined.
jsdom focus semantics differ from WebKit for elements inside a closed <details>. The focus tests do not prove the real webview behavior.
Callout's default kind (amber vs blue) was not provided. It is assumed amber for inv.pre2.note.
Line numbers are approximate, derived from the provided full-file text.
